0022600139.text: The Warriors (0-3, on a three-game losing streak, 4th in the Pacific and 14th in the West) visit the Timberwolves (3-1, 3rd in the Northwest and 6th in the West) in Golden State's fifth game of the season. Golden State is 0-2 on the road, while Minnesota is 1-0 at home, and the Warriors are without Jimmy Butler III (knee surgery), Kristaps Porzingis (illness), and Moses Moody (knee surgery), while the Timberwolves are without Donte DiVincenzo (Achilles surgery). The 2026-27 season series has no games yet, and the teams last met in San Francisco on March 13, 2026, when Golden State lost 127-117; in 2025-26, the Warriors lost 1-3.
